# Codex task instructions

This repository uses a GitHub Actions workflow that turns an Issue labeled codex-task into a Codex implementation and Pull Request.
Keep changes focused on the requested issue.
1. Inspect the repository before editing.
2. Implement the issue.
3. Run the most relevant available checks, such as npm run build.
4. Do not commit or push; the workflow does that.
5. Do not modify unrelated files.
